{{Quote|Shae Vizla's taken down half the Dar'manda on Mek-Sha, but hasn't gotten any closer to this "Field Marshal" Kol.|[[Hylo Visz]]|<ref name="TOR:CP" />}}
In [[3626 BBY]],<ref name="TOR_updates" /> during the [[Mandalorian civil war (Third Galactic War)|Mandalorian civil war]] between the [[Mandalorian Trat'ade|Mandalore the Avenger's faction]] and the [[Hidden Chain]], [[Mandalore the Avenger]] undertook a '''mission''' to [[Mek-Sha]] to track down [[Heta Kol]], a renegade [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] who had recently ambushed her prized ship, the ''[[Spirit of Vengeance II]]''. Heta Kol vanished after the attack and Shae's goal was to find her and bring her to justice. Shae was following leads that would eventually point her towards [[Dar'manda]], the mercenary group led by [[Indigo (Mandalorian)|Indigo]].<ref name="Bottled Fury" />
